Platform Features

Everything you need for
a perfect journey

From booking to destination — we've got every step covered with cutting-edge technology.

Instant Booking

Book tickets in under 2 seconds with our streamlined checkout. Tatkal, General, Ladies quota — all supported.

Live GPS Tracking

Real-time train location, platform info, delay updates and ETA — powered by Indian Railways live feed.

Instant Refunds

Cancel anytime. Refunds processed in 3-5 business days directly to your payment source.

RailAI Assistant

AI-powered travel recommendations, best routes, price predictions and 24/7 chat support.

Station Explorer

Browse amenities, platform maps, food options and facilities for 500+ Indian Railway stations.

Secure Payments

UPI, cards, net banking & wallets — all protected with bank-grade encryption and fraud detection.
